Equipment
 Gate Valve HV (1A-HV-001)
 Alstom USA

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be 
 performed on yearly bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.
This valves is used for isolating HP main steam (when outage HRSG)

The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed Hassan, tested by eng. Abd El-Meguid 
 El-Henawy, approved by general manager eng. Magdy Okba, revised by eng. Magdy Hegazy 
 MDEPC inspection and quality control engineer and approved by eng. Ahmed Sawan head sector of Nubaria PS.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd EL-Gelil ; MDEPC inspection & 
 quality control general manager, MPIS coordinator , and certified by 
 accountant Mohamed Nageeb : MDEPC planning & financial predicating head 
 sector, and supervisor of inspection & quality controls head sector.

 mask ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of the valve actuator.
Disconnect electric terminals of the actuator.

Isolate the valve mechanically by closing isolating manual

Complete maintenance 
 tools set .

 wrench

Handled with lifting 
 lugs

Puller.

Disconnect electric and( IC) 
 terminal of the actuator.
Disconnect the actuator.

Unscrew the nuts from the 
 gland bolts and remove the gland bolts. Part no 15.

Unscrew retaining nut part no 
 19 .

Loosen the yoke 22 to end to 
 remove parts no 20&19&18+positoner.

Unscrew body bolts part no14 
 &15.

Remove the packing washer part 
 no.8 and segments part no4.

Lift the bonnet carefully to 
 keep the seal ring graphite part no10.

Lift the wedge and stem 
 part no 4&5.

Thoroughly wipe all parts with 
 solvent and clean cloth.
Examine the following parts for pitting or scratches: SEAT - Sealing surface &STEM - Packing area &WEDGE - Sealing surface

Grease all threaded parts with 
 molykote
Change seal ring graphite.

Insert the stem/wedge-assembly 
 into the valve-body.

Insert the seal ring in the 
 bonnet .

Insert the bonnet into the 
 valve body (with markings )

Place the gland over the 
 stem.

Put the yoke together with the 
 gland-flange over the stem.

Fix the gland-flange with the 
 stud bolts.
Fix the body bolts.

Tighten the nuts of the 
 studs bolts. (to compress the packing)

Loosen the nuts of the 
 stud bolts.

Now again carefully tighten the 
 nuts of the stud bolts.

In case of leaking tighten the 
 nuts of the gland bolts. carefully, until leakage stops
Insert the actuator.

Connect the electric and (IC) 
 terminal.

Now again carefully tighten the
